The layout check reads the width of the text from the full lines of this first page, which holds no image. The text is 6 in wide, and the metadata width of 5 in with its 1.5 in gap fills it, so a figure with no width takes 40%. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.
